name: University of Ljubljana
summary: Founded 1919, about 38,000 students in 26 faculties; one English-taught bachelor's, Business and Economics, open to students schooled abroad.

ib.text: The IB Diploma counts as a Slovenian general matura with no recognition procedure; the IB certificate alone does not. Places are ranked on converted grades; B2 English is needed.

apply.via: eVŠ national portal (joint call for enrolment)

programmes.name: University Degree Programme in Business and Economics
programmes.about: A three-year business and economics degree (180 ECTS) at the School of Economics and Business; the English version adds second-year specialisations in International Business, Marketing or Tourism.
programmes.ib: B2 English is required, shown by a school-leaving certificate that includes English or a B2 exam certificate.
programmes.selectionNote: If places run short: 60% school-leaving exam results, 40% grades of the last two school years. 2026/27 rules; 2027 not yet published.

notes: The English version is capped at 120 places for Slovenian and foreign students together; students who finished school abroad may choose it without restriction.
Full-time study is free for EU citizens in the Slovenian version, but the page sets a €3,400 a year fee for the English implementation; ask the Faculty whether it applies to you.
Only the Business and Economics degree is taught in English at first-cycle level; the university's other bachelor's are in Slovenian.
